in_sanskrit.name: Rajasik
in_sanskrit.meaning: Having the quality of passion or desire
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'rajas' (passion, desire, or color) and the suffix '-ik' (related to or having the quality of).

in_hindi.name: राजिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'rajas' (राजा, king or ruler) and the suffix '-ik' (कारक, doer or maker).

in_tamil.name: ராஜிக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'rajas' (ராஜா, குறியிட்டவர், king or ruler) and the suffix '-ik' (இடம்பிருக்கப்பட்டவர், one who is related to or has the quality of).

in_telugu.name: రాజిక్
